pmFiber.name: TitaniaBend PANDA PM Fiber (1550 nm)
pmFiber.description: Corning 공개 자료: attenuation <4.0 dB/km, MFD 8.5–9.2 µm, beat length <5.0 mm, cladding 80 ±1 또는 125 ±1 µm, coating 165 ±10 또는 245 ±10 µm. R4 mm에서 10회 감았을 때 손실 <0.5 dB @1550 nm, 온도 범위 −40~+85°C. 이 초소형 굽힘 사양은 장거리 전송선 사양과 직접 비교하지 말고 광엔진/짧은 점퍼용 기준으로 보세요.

dataFiber.name: Corning® CPO FlexConnect™ Fiber
dataFiber.description: Bend-resilient O-band single-mode fiber optimized for short CPO links. Designed to reduce MPI penalty in lengths under 2 m, with 9.2 µm MFD at 1310 nm and applications requiring bend radii below 10 mm.

connector.name: MMC® Connector with PRIZM® TMT Expanded-Beam Ferrule
connector.description: Lens-based contactless expanded-beam interface for high-density AI/CPO connectivity. Corning states 16-fiber launch configurations designed to scale toward 32 fibers, blind-mate capability, 3–6× density versus traditional solutions and an insertion-loss target as low as 0.5 dB for the announced Q4 2026 configuration.
